lines.en: label tsuneyospring2:
{i}Somewhere kind of far-ish from where you are right now or something...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在离你现在所在的地方有点远……之类的什么地方……{/i}

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits1
: Why in Grom’s great green gonads did you bring me here, Tsuneyo? You know my race does not fare well when exposed to the light of Ra.
lines.zh: : 以 Grom 那对伟大的绿睾丸起誓，你到底为什么带我来这儿，Tsuneyo？你知道我的种族暴露在 Ra 的光芒下会很不舒服。

lines.en: : You know what they say, Emerald Guardian — when in Rome, go to an amusement park.
lines.zh: : 俗话说得好，翡翠守护者——入乡随俗，到了罗马就得去游乐园。

lines.en: : So we’re in Rome now?
lines.zh: : 那我们现在是在罗马？

lines.en: : No wonder why men are always thinking of their empire. This seems lively and exciting. Just look at all of the shadowy figures happily roaming around.
lines.zh: : 难怪男人总惦记着他们的帝国。这儿看起来热闹又刺激。看看那些在暗处快乐游荡的身影。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits2
: You know, when you told me you had a quest you needed help with, I was kind of hoping it would be one I could handle from a gaming chair.
lines.zh: : 你知道，你说有个任务需要我帮忙的时候，我还挺希望是那种能坐在游戏椅上搞定的。

lines.en: : What is earth if not a gaming chair for experiencing pleasant outdoor excursions with a small Caucasian girl?
lines.zh: : 如果地球不是为了和一个白人小女孩一起体验愉快的户外远足而存在的游戏椅，那它又是什么？

lines.en: : A planet, I think.
lines.zh: : 一颗行星，我觉得。

lines.en: : Planet-shmanet, Janet. I hope you brought your questing pants.
lines.zh: : 行星不行星的，Janet。希望你穿了做任务的裤子。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits3
: Are shorts okay? And you’re not going to make me ride anything, are you? I’ll get motion sickness and I’m trying not to throw up in front of people anymore.
lines.zh: : 短裤行吗？还有你不会让我去坐什么游乐设施吧？我会晕的，而且我现在尽量不在别人面前吐了。

lines.en: : I am not quite sure what I am going to make you do. I just felt that I was supposed to bring someone here.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定要让你做什么。我只是觉得自己应该带个人来这儿。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits4
: {i}Hah...{/i}why’s it always an escort quest?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}为什么总是护送任务啊？

lines.en: : Just do your best to not aggro any unnecessary mobs as my magical energy comes from the moon and I can’t imagine that it will be logging in for at least another hour or two.
lines.zh: : 尽量别去拉不必要的怪，我的魔法能量来自月亮，而且我估计它至少还要一两个小时才会上线。

lines.en: : Do you want the experience points or not? Because it is beginning to sound as if you don’t.
lines.zh: : 你到底想不想要经验值？因为听起来你好像不想要。

lines.en: : Not if they come at the expense of my energy. I must think of self-preservation before anything, Kendo Princess. And thanks to the Dark Successor’s homework, I haven’t had a single bar of rested in weeks.
lines.zh: : 要以我的精力为代价的话，那就不想要。我必须把自我保护放在第一位，剑道公主。而且托黑暗继承者的作业的福，我已经好几周没有一格“充分休息”了。

lines.en: : Then leave and I will do this on my own.
lines.zh: : 那就走吧，我自己来。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits5

: I understand that you have accepted your position as a “side heroine” in the life of the man you routinely call the protagonist of our story, but that man has all but vanished and {i}I{/i} am the protagonist now.
lines.zh: : 我明白，你已经接受了自己在那个男人生命中“配角女主”的位置——你总称呼他为我们故事的主角——可那个人几乎已经消失不见了，现在{i}我{/i}才是我故事的主角。

lines.en: : I do not have the time for side characters. And I have asked you to join me today for the sake of my quest, which makes you my main heroine.
lines.zh: : 我没有时间应付配角。而我今天请你来是为了我的任务，这让你成为我的主线女主。

lines.en: : But as always, you refuse to return the favor and fervor that I give to you when you take the time out of {i}your{/i} life to show me the things {i}you{/i} love. It’s the cooking contest all over again.
lines.zh: : 可一如既往，当我抽出{i}我{/i}生命中的时间向你展示{i}我{/i}热爱的东西时，你从不回报我给予你的那份心意与热忱。就像那次料理比赛一样。

lines.en: : Do you really have to scold me, though? I had no idea you loved amusement parks until literally right now.
lines.zh: : 可你非得训我吗？我可是字面意义上“刚刚”才知道你喜欢游乐园。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits6
: I don’t like amusement parks.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢游乐园。

lines.en: : Well, then what does your lecture have to do with anything?!
lines.zh: : 那你刚才那番说教跟这有什么关系啊？！

lines.en: : Just once, I would like to have you do something I want without having to talk you into it. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你有一次主动去做我想做的事，而不用我费口舌劝你。就这样。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits7
: There’s some reason I needed to come here, but I’m unsure as to what it actually is. And I believed that retracing my steps would be the only way to figure that out.
lines.zh: : 我必须来这儿是有某种原因的，但我不确定那究竟是什么。而我认为，重走旧路是弄明白这件事的唯一办法。

lines.en: : The problem is that I have never been here before. I’ve only seen this place in dreams — so the act of retracing {i}anything{/i} seems difficult.
lines.zh: : 问题是我从未来过这儿。我只在梦里见过这个地方——所以“重走”{i}什么{/i}的似乎很难。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits8
: Dreams, you say?...
: Something of the sort, at least. I can’t quite wrap my head around it.
lines.zh: : 大概算是吧。我实在想不明白。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : I understand what’s happening now...
lines.zh: : 我现在明白是怎么回事了……

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits9
: You do?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Those aren’t dreams you’re having! They’re memories from a different timeline! A previous life you’ve lived! And you’re trying to get them back because they’re important to you!
lines.zh: : 那不是梦！那是来自另一条时间线的记忆！是你前世经历过的事！你想要把它们找回来，因为它们对你很重要！

lines.en: : So, you are saying I {i}have{/i} been here before?
lines.zh: : 所以你是说，我以前{i}来过{/i}这里？

lines.en: : Most assuredly so! I’ve watched more than enough anime to know just how often Japanese girls are getting wrapped up in tragic, time-based conflicts!
lines.zh: : 千真万确！我看了那么多动画，太清楚日本女孩有多常卷进悲剧性的时空纠葛里了！

lines.en: : Which means you were right, Kendo Princess! You {i}are{/i} the protagonist after all!
lines.zh: : 也就是说你是对的，剑道公主！你果然{i}才是{/i}主角！

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits10
: Which {i}also{/i} means I’m finally the main heroine! Yes! Yes, it’s all so clear now! I just needed to wait for a yuri spin-off! Thank you anime-Jesus!
lines.zh: : {i}也{/i}就是说我终于成了主线女主！没错！没错，现在一切都清楚了！我只要等一个百合外传就行了！感谢动画耶稣！

lines.en: : Does this mean you will participate in the excursion without being a pansy-ass bitch about it?
lines.zh: : 那是不是意味着你会参加这次远足，而不是当个怂包娘们？

lines.en: scene black
: {i}Participate?!{/i} I’m gonna lead the charge like all good heroines do!
lines.zh: : {i}参加{/i}？！我要像所有优秀的女主那样带头冲锋！

lines.en: : Oh! But first, takoyaki. Come!
lines.zh: : 哦！不过先吃章鱼烧。来！

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits11
: Aaaaand now comes the part where we have to wait two weeks to be able to eat it without burning our tongues off. Fun.
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊，接下来就是得等上两周才能吃、不然会烫掉舌头的环节了。真开心。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits12
: What’s going on? Are you unlocking another memory? Does it have anything to do with the lewd arrangement of ingredients? Do you have secret sexual trauma I’ve never learned about?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你又解锁了什么记忆？和食材那淫靡的摆盘有关吗？你有什么我从不知道的隐秘性创伤吗？

lines.en: : Tell me so I can use my heroine powers to {i}fix{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 告诉我吧，好用我的女主之力{i}治好{/i}你。

lines.en: : This does seem familiar. Perhaps I’ve eaten this in one of my dreams that aren’t actually dreams according to your animation logic.
lines.zh: : 这确实很熟悉。也许我在某个梦里吃过这个——按你的动画逻辑，那不是梦。

lines.en: : It would also help explain why the vendor started crying and screaming as soon as he saw you. There must have been some sort of tragic occurrence where-
lines.zh: : 这也能解释为什么摊主一看到你就开始又哭又叫。一定是发生过什么悲惨的事，比如——

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits13
: Ah! Tsuneyo! This must have been how you died! You choked on takoyaki!
lines.zh: : 啊！Tsuneyo！你一定是这么死的！你被章鱼烧噎死了！

lines.en: : I am a warrior. I would never be defeated by balls.
lines.zh: : 我是个战士。我绝不会被丸子打败。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits14
: Unless...they were {i}poisoned.{/i}
lines.zh: : 除非……那是{i}毒丸子{/i}。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits15
: Poisoned balls...the worst kind.
lines.zh: : 毒丸子……最糟的一种。

lines.en: : Drop ‘em, Kendo Princess. Show those vendors we don’t take kindly to assassination attempts around here.
lines.zh: : 扔掉吧，剑道公主。让那些摊主看看，我们这儿可不吃暗杀这一套。

lines.en: : Good idea, Emerald Guardian. Thank you for saving my life.
lines.zh: : 好主意，翡翠守护者。谢谢你救了我一命。

lines.en: : The best healers are proactive, not reactive. Let this be a lesson to you going forward.
lines.zh: : 最好的治疗者是主动的，不是被动的。往后你就以此为鉴吧。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits16
: {i}Now! To find food that we can actually eat! Mount up, Kendo Princess!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}现在！去找真正能吃的东西！上马，剑道公主！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Come, legs. Let us find the secrets of my death together.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}来吧，腿。让我们一起去寻找我死亡的秘密。{/i}

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits17

lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man

lines.en: : I worked so hard on those balls, man...
lines.spk: Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 我那么努力做那些丸子，哥们……

lines.en: : I know, buddy. I know. Some people just don’t appreciate art.
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 我知道，兄弟。我知道。有些人就是不懂得欣赏艺术。

lines.en: : They just walk all over me, man. I can’t do it anymore. I’ll never make him proud! I’ll never amount to anything!
lines.spk: Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 他们只会踩着我，哥们。我干不下去了。我永远没法让他骄傲！我永远成不了器！

lines.en: : It’s okay, Tony...
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 没事的，Tony……

lines.en: scene black
: You’ll always be my guy....
lines.spk: Frank: Friend of Tony: Takoyaki Son, Son of Takoyaki Man
lines.zh: : 你永远都是我的人……

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits18
: Tsuneyo? What’s wrong? You’ve seen the corpses of so many chickens throughout your life. Why are these ones getting you down?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？怎么了？你这辈子见过的鸡尸首够多了。为什么这些让你这么消沉？

lines.en: : It’s just that {i}this{/i} seems familiar as well. Like I’m experiencing the same events all over again, but coming no closer to uncovering the truth.
lines.zh: : 只是{i}这个{/i}也让我觉得熟悉。像是又把同样的事经历了一遍，却一点都没接近真相。

lines.en: : This one too? The takoyaki is one thing, but if {i}everything{/i} you eat is killing you, it could imply that there’s a secret criminal organization directly targeting you. And that’s {i}way{/i} harder to fix..
lines.zh: : 这个也是？章鱼烧也就算了，可要是你吃的{i}每一样东西{/i}都在杀死你，那就意味着有个秘密犯罪组织在专门针对你。那可就难办{i}多了{/i}。

lines.en: : We’d need a whole team of heroines to band together in order to stand-up to a group like that. This quest is turning into an entire game, Kendo Princess. We must be vigilant or-
lines.zh: : 我们得有一整队女主联手，才能对抗那样的组织。这个任务已经变成一整个游戏了，剑道公主。我们必须保持警惕，否则——

lines.en: : What if...it’s something else entirely?
lines.zh: : 如果……完全是另一回事呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits19
: I’m not quite sure. But something about the way these mangled and seasoned corpses make me feel does not scream “fear” to me.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。但这些烤得焦烂、撒满调料的尸首给我的感觉，并不像是在喊“恐惧”。

lines.en: : Besides, the only organization I am affiliated with in any way is the Produce Delivery Administration, and chicken is certainly not a vegetable as far as my culinary knowledge extends.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我唯一有任何关联的组织就是农产品配送管理局，而据我的厨艺知识所及，鸡肉肯定不是蔬菜。

lines.en: : Well, if these memories aren’t sticking out to you because they’re scaring you, how {i}are{/i} they making you feel?
lines.zh: : 那么，如果这些记忆让你在意并不是因为吓到了你，那它们让你有什么感觉？

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits20
: It’s difficult to say...it’s not a way I’ve ever felt before.
lines.zh: : 很难说……这是一种我从未有过感觉。

lines.en: : But when I’m holding this platter...inhaling the scent of charcoal and listening to choruses of laughter in the background...it’s like...
lines.zh: : 但当我端着这盘东西……闻着炭火的味道，听着背景里此起彼伏的笑声……就好像……

lines.en: : It’s like I am missing something.
lines.zh: : 就好像我缺了点什么。

lines.en: : Like there is an element to this experience that once existed and just...{i}doesn’t{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 就好像这段经历里曾存在某个要素，如今却……{i}不复存在{/i}了。

lines.en: : But what could that be?
lines.zh: : 可那会是什么呢？

lines.en: : And why does it make me feel somewhat empty?
lines.zh: : 又为什么让我觉得有些空虚？

lines.en: : The only explanation is that noodles are involved in some way. I do not feel this strongly about anything else.
lines.zh: : 唯一的解释是，这里面有面条的参与。我对别的东西从没有这么强烈的感觉。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Tsuneyo...the way you’re talking about it now makes it sound kind of like you’ve gone on a date here or something.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Tsuneyo……你现在说的这些，听起来有点像你在这儿约过会之类的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits21
: That is impossible. I harbor no romantic interest for anyone and would never react this strongly to such a thing.
lines.zh: : 不可能。我对任何人都没有浪漫的兴趣，也绝不会对这种事有这么强烈的反应。

lines.en: : You haven’t experienced anything like that in {i}this{/i} life, sure. But what if you’re part of some kind of game where love {i}transcends{/i} time? And you need to find your way back to your lover? Or-
lines.zh: : 你的确在{i}这一世{/i}没有过这种经历。可万一你是某个游戏的一部分，而爱能{i}超越{/i}时间呢？你得找回回到你爱人身边的路？或者——

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits22
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : If you brought {i}me{/i} here...
lines.zh: : 如果你带{i}我{/i}来这儿……

lines.en: : Do you...do you think that might mean we...
lines.zh: : 你……你觉得这会不会意味着我们……

lines.en: : In another life...
lines.zh: : 在另一世里……

lines.en: : You and I...together...
lines.zh: : 你和我……在一起……

lines.en: : I do not understand. What are you implying?
lines.zh: : 我不明白。你在暗示什么？

lines.en: : That we...that maybe {i}my{/i} memories are also...and...you know...
lines.zh: : 就是我们……也许{i}我{/i}的记忆也是……而且……你知道的……

lines.en: : I’m still confused. Be direct or I will not understand.
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白。直说吧，否则我听不懂。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits23
: I’m saying we must have been in love in another life and are now reliving this date because the universe is trying to get us back together!
lines.zh: : 我是说，我们在上一世一定是相爱的，而现在正在重温这场约会，因为宇宙想让我们重新在一起！

lines.en: : Your feelings for me are so strong that they’re manipulating time itself! Your memories are creeping back in!
lines.zh: : 你对我的感情强烈到扭曲了时间本身！你的记忆正在一点点回来！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Kendo Princess! I’ll try to get mine back as soon as-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，剑道公主！我会尽快把我的记忆找回来的——

lines.en: : Emerald Guardian.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者。

lines.en: : I’m sorry! I’m trying!
lines.zh: : 对不起！我在努力了！

lines.en: : There is no need to apologize.
lines.zh: : 不必道歉。

lines.en: : When I said I harbor no romantic interest for anyone, that included you. You are a friend. And you are a very good friend, but that is all.
lines.zh: : 我说对任何人都没有浪漫兴趣的时候，其中也包括你。你是我的朋友。而且是非常好的朋友，但也仅此而已。

lines.en: : But you don’t know that for sure! Your memories are-
lines.zh: : 可你并不能确定啊！你的记忆是——

lines.en: : Emerald Guardian, I am a heterosexual woman. Such a thing would never happen between us.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者，我是个异性恋女性。这种事在我们之间永远不会发生。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits24
: Oh...right. I forgot straight people still exist in 2020. My bad.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。我都忘了 2020 年还有直人存在。我的错。

lines.en: : What’s curious is if romantic feelings {i}are{/i} at the core of this emptiness....that there are only two men in my life who it could be. And one of them is my father.
lines.zh: : 有意思的是，如果这份空虚的核心{i}是{/i}浪漫感情……那我生命中符合条件的男人只有两个。而其中一个是我的父亲。

lines.en: : Maybe you just...like older guys then?
lines.zh: : 也许你只是……喜欢年纪大的男人？

lines.en: : No...it must be something else.
lines.zh: : 不……一定是别的原因。

lines.en: scene black
: Come. We’ll keep looking. There must be another hint somewhere.
lines.zh: : 走吧。我们继续找。一定还有别的线索在某处。

lines.en: : Wait, are we not eating first?!
lines.zh: : 等等，我们不先吃点东西吗？！

lines.en: : Eat and walk. We don’t have time.
lines.zh: : 边走边吃。没时间了。

lines.en: : I thought we weren’t supposed to do that in this country?!
lines.zh: : 我记得这个国家不是不让这么做吗？！

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits25
: Gaaaaaah! Can we go home now? We’ve been here for hours and are still no closer to the truth.
lines.zh: : 啊————！我们现在能回家了吗？都在这儿待了几个小时了，还是一点都没接近真相。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits26
: Or at least no closer to you accepting that love might actually be the culprit after all.
lines.zh: : 或者说，至少一点都没接近“让你承认爱说不定才是真凶”这件事。

lines.en: : Death seems more plausible when compared to that.
lines.zh: : 相比之下，死亡似乎更说得通。

lines.en: : Not really, Kendo Princess. And the more I think about it, the more sense it makes. I mean, there’s no way you’ve been killed by {i}every{/i} food item here, right?
lines.zh: : 不见得，剑道公主。而且我越想越觉得有道理。我是说，你不可能被这里的{i}每一样{/i}食物都杀死过吧？

lines.en: : That does sound implausible. But it could be the universe’s way of telling me to always prepare a meal at home instead of allowing other vendors to price-gouge me.
lines.zh: : 那确实不太可能。但这也许是宇宙在告诉我，要在家好好做饭，别让别的摊主宰我。

lines.en: : Or...you could have gone on a date here.
lines.zh: : 或者……你在这儿约过会。

lines.en: : Is that really such a bad thing?
lines.zh: : 那真的是件很糟的事吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits27
: What if our approach in general, treating this as the convergence of timelines, is what’s flawed? What if it’s more complicated than that?
lines.zh: : 如果我们整体的思路——把它当成时间线的交汇——本身就是错的呢？如果事情比那更复杂呢？

lines.en: : Chances are it {i}is{/i} more complicated than that. But I start to zone out whenever shows start getting to the specific metaphysics of situations like this. Just say “time stuff” and leave it at that. GG.
lines.zh: : 大概率{i}是{/i}更复杂。不过剧一开始讲这种具体的形而上学，我就开始走神了。说一句“时间的事”就够了。GG。

lines.en: : But what if...it’s the opposite?
lines.zh: : 但如果……恰好相反呢？

lines.en: : The opposite? What?
lines.zh: : 相反？什么相反？

lines.en: : What if...
lines.zh: : 如果……

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits28
: {i}I’ve been predicting the future this whole time?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我这从头到尾一直在预知未来？{/i}

lines.en: : Odin’s ovaries, you’ve cracked the code! This whole time, all those things felt familiar because they were {i}premonitions!{/i} You’re a soothsayer!
lines.zh: : 奥丁的卵巢啊，你破解了密码！原来如此，那些东西之所以让你觉得熟悉，是因为它们是{i}预兆{/i}！你是个预言者！

lines.en: : I’ve always known my presence was soothing. This is no surprise to me.
lines.zh: : 我一直都知道我的存在让人安心。这我倒不意外。

lines.en: : Not what that means but yeah!
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思，不过也行！

lines.en: : What else happens, then? What else do you see that hasn’t come true yet?
lines.zh: : 那还会发生什么？你还看到了什么尚未成真的事？

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我看到……

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits29
: I see...
lines.zh: : 我看到……

lines.en: scene black
: I see that.
lines.zh: : 我看到了那个。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits30
: Did I really have to wait all the way down here?
lines.zh: : 我真的一路等到了这儿吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits31
: Thank you for coming on such short notice. I understand that you’ve been very busy being useless lately and do not have much time to engage in normal human activities anymore.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你接到通知就来了。我知道你最近忙着一事无成，没什么时间进行正常的人类活动了。

lines.en: : I mean...this call has some pretty serious implications and turning it down would have been a terrible idea for a lot of different reasons, but yeah. You’re welcome, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这个电话牵扯的东西挺严重的，拒绝它从很多方面看都是个烂主意，不过行吧。不客气，我想。

lines.en: : This happened sooner than I thought it would, though.
lines.zh: : 只是这比我想象中来得要早。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits32
: I see. So you must already know about my powers.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那你一定已经知道我的能力了。

lines.en: : Your what?
lines.zh: : 你的什么？

lines.en: : As it turns out, I am what the Emerald Guardian calls a “soothsayer.” Which means that I can predict the future, and that is somehow soothing.
lines.zh: : 事实证明，我就是翡翠守护者所说的“预言者”。意思是我能预知未来，而这不知怎的很让人安心。

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene tsuneyorevisits33
: A terrible fate will soon befall you, bro. And while I do not know the specifics of that terrible fate, I know that it exists.
lines.zh: : 一场可怕的命运即将降临在你身上，兄弟。虽然我不知道那具体是什么，但我知道它存在。

lines.en: : And I know that it is terrible because you are involved. And that automatically {i}makes{/i} it terrible.
lines.zh: : 而我知道它很可怕，因为牵涉到你。而只要牵涉到你，就自动{i}变得{/i}很可怕。

lines.en: : And it must be true as I’ve been seeing this very image in my sleep. Being up here on this metal wheel with you. I see it sometimes when I blink too.
lines.zh: : 而且这一定是真的，因为我在睡梦里一遍又一遍地看到这个画面。和你一起站在这个金属轮子上。我眨眼的时候有时也能看到。

lines.en: : I’ve seen everything here today over and over and over again...and so I took it upon myself to investigate why as it was starting to become distracting in my daily life.
lines.zh: : 今天这里的一切，我都一遍又一遍地看过……所以我决定自己去查查原因，因为它已经开始干扰我的日常生活了。

lines.en: : But seeing as I have now informed you of your impending terrible fate in a soothing manner, my mind should go back to normal and I can start thinking more about noodles again.
lines.zh: : 不过既然我已经用一种令人安心的方式告知了你即将到来的可怕命运，我的脑子应该能恢复正常，可以重新多想想面条了。

lines.en: : You are welcome, by the way. I will not charge for my services the first time. But any tragedies I prevent in the future will require a small donation. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，不客气。第一次我不收费。但今后我预防的任何悲剧，都需要一点点捐助。感谢您的理解。

lines.en: : You really think you’re seeing the future?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得自己在看到未来？

lines.en: : It’s the only thing that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 这是唯一说得通的解释。

lines.en: : You don’t think those visions might be memories?
lines.zh: : 你就不觉得那些画面可能是记忆？

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits34
: The Guardian and I toyed with the idea, but ultimately decided this made more sense as we could not come up with a reasonable explanation for why I was ever here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我和守护者琢磨过这个想法，但最终认为“预知”更说得通，因为我们想不出一个合理的解释，说明我当初为什么会来这儿。

lines.en: : You brought me here.
lines.zh: : 是你带我来这儿的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits35
: Yes, and I have already thanked you for coming. So it is only right to thank me as well for-
lines.zh: : 是的，而我已经谢过你来了。所以你也该谢谢我——

lines.en: : No, I mean you brought me here {i}in the past.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，我是说，你{i}以前{/i}带我来过这儿。

lines.en: : ...What?
: This {i}is{/i} a memory. We’ve done this before.
lines.zh: : 这{i}是{/i}一段记忆。我们以前做过这件事。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits36
: We’ve...what?...
lines.zh: : 我们……什么？……

lines.en: : No...I’m a soothsayer. I’m predicting the future. I’ve summoned you here to protect you from something.
lines.zh: : 不……我是个预言者。我在预知未来。我把你召唤到这儿，是为了保护你免受某种东西的伤害。

lines.en: : You haven’t.
lines.zh: : 你没有。

lines.en: : I have.
lines.zh: : 我有。

lines.en: : You haven’t, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 你没有，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : You’re remembering something you’re not supposed to remember. But I don’t know {i}why{/i} you’re remembering it and that...is confusing to me. But we can try and figure that out later.
lines.zh: : 你在记起一些你不该记起的事。但我不知道你{i}为什么{/i}会记起它，这……让我很困惑。不过我们可以以后再想办法弄清楚。

lines.en: : Why...were we here? The Guardian made it sound like this would be a date.
lines.zh: : 为什么……我们会在这儿？守护者说得好像这会是一场约会。

lines.en: : It kind of was.
lines.zh: : 差不多就是。

lines.en: : But you are not my boyfriend. You’re-
lines.zh: : 可你不是我男朋友。你是——

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits37
: My...husband...
lines.zh: : 我的……丈夫……

lines.en: : I asked you to take me here again...
lines.zh: : 我让你再带我来这儿一次……

lines.en: : And it looks like I didn’t even have to.
lines.zh: : 看来我甚至都不用开口。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits38
: Ngh!
lines.zh: : 嗯啊！

lines.en: : Tsuneyo? Are you okay?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？你没事吧？

lines.en: : It’s...my head...
lines.zh: : 是……我的头……

lines.en: : Something...ngh...
lines.zh: : 有什么……嗯啊……

lines.en: : It hurts!...
: Just take a deep breath and-
lines.zh: : 深呼吸，然后——

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits39
: Hah...hah...hah......ngah!
: Just take a deep breath and remember who you are. Not {i}where{/i} you are.
lines.zh: : 深呼吸，记住你是谁。而不是你{i}在哪儿{/i}。

lines.en: : Do you...know what’s happening to me?...
lines.zh: : 你……知道我身上发生了什么吗？……

lines.en: : Do you...know what this is?...
lines.zh: : 你……知道这是什么吗？……

lines.en: : A little yes, a little no. And I’m mostly winging it right now, but it’s something we might be able to figure out if-
lines.zh: : 知道一点，也不知道一点。而且我现在基本是在瞎蒙，不过如果——我们也许能弄清楚。

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits40
: Hah...hah...hah!
: It’s something we might be able to figure out if we can talk about it.
lines.zh: : 如果我们能谈谈，也许能弄清楚。

lines.en: : It’s not just you. The world is looping.
lines.zh: : 不只是你。这个世界在循环。

lines.en: : Stop...
lines.zh: : 停下……

lines.en: : Ayane and Makoto know about it already. And if you can bring yourself to listen-
lines.zh: : Ayane 和 Makoto 已经知道了。如果你能听得进去——

lines.en: scene tsuneyorevisits41
: Si...lence!...
: I’ll get in contact with them. We can tell you everything. Just try to-
lines.zh: : 我会联系他们。我们可以把一切都告诉你。只要试着——

lines.en: scene black
: Enough! Enough! I’ve heard enough!
lines.zh: : 够了！够了！我听够了！
: 哈……嗯啊……嗯！

lines.en: : Tomorrow...
lines.zh: : 明天……

lines.en: : Bring them...to Tojo Ramen...
lines.zh: : 带他们……来 Tojo Ramen……

lines.en: : Bring them...
lines.zh: : 带他们……

lines.en: : To me...
lines.zh: : 来见我……
